standard_prerequisites.name: Sections commute with directed colimits
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Sites, the lemma computing sections of a directed colimit as the colimit of the sections
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies condition (2) of the criterion through the identity Hom(j_!O_U, F) = F(U).

core_obligations: Choose the generating set (proof lines 14045-14048): take S to be the set of modules j_!O_U with U a quasi-compact object of C and apply the compactness criterion for generators.

Check the two conditions (proof lines 14049-14057): condition (1) holds because every module is a quotient of a direct sum of such sheaves, which uses the assumption that every object is covered by quasi-compact ones; condition (2) holds because Hom(j_!O_U, F) = F(U) commutes with direct sums by the commutation of sections with directed colimits.
proof_roadmap: Apply the generator criterion to the set of extension sheaves over quasi-compact objects.
Verify the two hypotheses using the quotient representation and the commutation of sections with colimits.
difficulty_reason: The lemma describes compact objects in the derived category when every object of the site admits a cover by quasi-compact objects: they are direct summands of finite complexes of extension sheaves (statement lines 14034-14042). The proof (proof lines 14044-14057) applies the generator criterion to the extension sheaves over quasi-compact objects and checks its two hypotheses. H2: one criterion with two verifications, written out.
